predicates.name: real temporary SQLite
predicates.expected_observable: <root>/state.sqlite exists; operational_schema.version == 2; aggregate factory:S0-PROBE stage DONE with candidate.independent_read_back_proven true
predicates.negative_control: a fresh root has no aggregate (KeyError) before start

predicates.name: disposable local bare Git remote
predicates.expected_observable: <root>/remote.git is bare; refs/heads/main advertises the baseline commit; refs/heads/candidate/<ref_safe(correlation)> advertises the candidate revision
predicates.negative_control: before start the candidate branch is not advertised

predicates.name: publication and fetch into a fresh verifier worktree
predicates.expected_observable: <root>/producer-read-back/producer-<correlation>/.git exists (producer read-back clone) and <root>/verifier-evidence/<revision>/.git exists (kernel custody clone); both resolve <revision>^{commit} == revision
predicates.negative_control: existing PY-06 proof: unpublished or mismatched branch is CandidateUnavailable (tests/invocation_runtime/test_runtime.py)

predicates.name: local work-management transport
predicates.expected_observable: <root>/work-management/receipts.jsonl holds release-proposed then execution-state-projected DONE for S0-PROBE, each read back after append; ready-snapshot.json digest matches the seeded items
predicates.negative_control: test: a reopened root with a different seed is refused (WorkRejected)

predicates.name: local provider transport
predicates.expected_observable: the WorkerProcess bound to RealWorkerProvider is ScriptedWorkerProcess with provider 'scripted'; no executable is configured

predicates.name: injected clock and IDs
predicates.expected_observable: every journal/receipt timestamp equals the epoch; candidate commit author and committer dates equal the epoch; the same manifest in a second isolated root yields the same candidate revision; a different epoch yields a different revision

predicates.name: durable scripted worker journal
predicates.expected_observable: <root>/worker-journal/journal.jsonl has invocation-started and invocation-outcome records for launch:S0-PROBE:0; a new provider over the same root reads back the identical outcome; a fresh root reads back None
predicates.negative_control: test: unknown invocation reads back None

predicates.name: credentials absent
predicates.expected_observable: no environment variable matching the credential denylist (TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|PASSWD|API_KEY|APIKEY|CREDENTIAL|PRIVATE_KEY, GIT_CONFIG_COUNT, GIT_ASKPASS, SSH_AUTH_SOCK) is present; no secret provider is constructed

predicates.name: enforced denied outbound network with attempted-network refusal
predicates.expected_observable: socket connect raises OSError with errno in {ENETUNREACH, EPERM, EACCES}; git ls-remote exits nonzero; the proof process net namespace inode differs from the launching test's
predicates.negative_control: C3; when the platform cannot create the namespace the status is NOT_ESTABLISHED and the verdict HOLD, never PASS

predicates.name: zero provider calls
predicates.expected_observable: sum of provider_calls over journal records == 0, definition: attempts by the worker process adapter to execute a provider executable

predicates.name: existing kernel unchanged
predicates.expected_observable: `git diff --quiet <baseline> -- <kernel_paths>` exits 0 in the source checkout and the blob ids equal kernel_unchanged_pin.blobs
predicates.negative_control: any kernel edit turns the check FAIL

predicates.name: success-collapse limitation reported
predicates.expected_observable: the store shows one correlation launch:S0-PROBE:0 carrying the terminal DONE state; no VERIFY-stage projection receipt exists; the report states independent_verifier_invocation NOT_ESTABLISHED and live_proof NOT_ESTABLISHED
predicates.negative_control: a report lacking the limitation fields is a FAIL of the report check

predicates.name: no scripted lifecycle transitions
predicates.expected_observable: every lifecycle receipt is emitted by LocalWorkManagement when FactoryCoordinator projects; the journal carries no lifecycle stage field; ScriptedWorkerProcess and ScriptedWorkerProvider hold no OperationalStore reference
predicates.negative_control: test asserts the scripted adapters expose no store attribute and the receipts sequence equals the kernel's projections

evidence_schema.run_report: quality-evidence-v1 document (schema_version 1.0, biu_id WO-220101, derived_from trajectory path, evidence_refs) extended with: fixture_id, verdict (PASS|FAIL|HOLD), hold_reasons, checks[] (id,status,expected,observed), substituted_boundaries, live_proof, network_denial, credentials_present, provider_calls_observed {value,definition}, kernel_unchanged, success_collapse_limitation, lifecycle_terminal_stage, candidate {branch,revision,locator}, injected_clock, recorder, recorded_at; token_usage and cost are NOT_APPLICABLE (no provider ran) never zero
evidence_schema.trajectory: execution-trajectory-v1 JSONL, biu_id S0-PROBE for lifecycle facts and WO-220101 for fixture-level facts, event types BIU_RELEASED, INVOCATION_STARTED, CANDIDATE_PUBLISHED, BIU_DONE plus ISOLATION_OBSERVED (network/credential observations) and SUCCESS_COLLAPSE_OBSERVED (new, documented)
evidence_schema.proven_red: same shape as docs/evidence/py10/proven-red.json: {ok, checks[{check, ok, detail}]} where each check names the intact command/exit and the fault command/exit

holds_policy: A measurement that cannot be taken is recorded as HOLD with its reason; it is never recorded as zero or PASS. Platform-sensitive network-denial evidence that cannot be obtained routes to HumanDecisionRequired, not local redesign.
not_claimed: rework, rejection, restart-after-crash, duplicate and delayed outcome scenarios
live GitHub, provider or bootstrap proof
any lifecycle transition performed by a script
